The PITFALLS of "being informed and updated" ●i never won a General Knowedge
Test at school. ●and am glad I did not ●i still don't bother what the god damn
world is upto ● why? As an industrialist, there is no shortage of my own daily
struggles to look into! However, ● as I get to interact with young
entrepreneurs of today, they are updated with every damn news under the
sun!Woah, amazing??? ●most of them today can get 100/100 in that GK
competition! ●and well why not? its a CONNECTED world, damn it! Right? WRONG!!
And here's why this ideology SUCKS: ◆God is in the detail. So is profit ◆If
you would breakup % of content you consume in a day by BUSINESS SENSE or
OTHERWISE , you would notice that 99% of news you consume is NOT "profitable"
to you WHAT TO DO? Try this 10 day experiment: ●Delete all news apps from your
mobile ●Try going without reading general news for 10 days ●You will be
shocked, the world around you will still exist. Yes, really! ●"PULL" your
business domain news ONLY during these 10 days,whenever you CRAVE for news ●
Even if it's boring , don't budge! OUTCOME :You will GUARANTEED get to see a
new focussed YOU! After all, Isn't being an interesting person to talk to, is
NOT AS IMPORTANT, as being the BEST in your field to talk to?
